mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL) erodes corporate profit margins and increases uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized change exceeds 3.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE) and strong job growth (PAYEMS) indicates a tight labor market that pressures the central bank to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly produces negative returns in less than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate operations and reduces earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of declining INDPRO, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST level and 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE) signals an economic slowdown that may prompt monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS) and rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS growth > 0.3% monthly and HOUST growth > 0.5% monthly produces positive returns in less than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply shock that exacerbates inflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.5% and INDPRO declines, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.
